summary: Iteration 286 — Catering-Inbox UX Fixes + Date-Validation. Backend: 11/11 tests passed. Frontend: All features verified including hydrated catering data, booking titles, item names, requester info, clickable attachments, catering status badges, and date validation in BookingDialog + BillingPanel.
critical_code_review_comments: CATERING-REQUESTS HYDRATION: GET /api/catering-requests returns items[i].item_name + item_unit, booking{title, start_at, end_at, resource_name}, requester{name, email}
BOOKINGS CATERING STATUS: GET /api/resource-bookings returns catering_status + catering_rejection_reason for bookings with catering_request_id
BACKWARD COMPAT: Bookings without catering_request_id correctly have no catering_status field (null)
CATERING-INBOX UI: Shows booking title as headline (not 'Anfrage XXXXXX'), item names (not cit_xxx), room + time range, requester name
ATTACHMENTS: Clickable links with data-testid=catering-attachment-link-{id} format
MEINE BUCHUNGEN: Catering status badges visible with data-testid=catering-status-{booking_id}, color-coded (emerald=confirmed, rose=rejected, slate=cancelled)
BOOKING DIALOG DATE VALIDATION: (1) HTML min attribute set on End input, (2) Auto-adjust End to Start+1h when Start changes, (3) Toast error 'Endzeit muss nach der Startzeit liegen' when End < Start

BILLING PANEL DATE VALIDATION: (1) HTML min attribute set on To-date input, (2) Auto-adjust To-date to From-date when From changes, (3) Toast error 'Bis-Datum darf nicht vor Von-Datum liegen' when To < From
